title: Lesson
description:
One lesson of scripture (characters/<id>/scripture.md or temple/scripture.md). Scripture stays Markdown that the owner edits directly; each lesson is one list item on one line (PS-12):

  - [L_<yyyymmdd>_<6 base32>] {role=verifier tribe=codex os=win32 fail_kind=tests_fail} <one imperative sentence>

The id and the scope head are optional. Only the sentence goes into a prompt. A line the owner writes without an id stays as written: the machine names it by a hash of its sentence (`T_<10 base32>`) and never writes into it. Lessons written by the Monk carry an id and point to the verdict they come from. A line whose scope the machine cannot read (unknown key or value) or that holds a hidden or bidirectional character never loads. `elvaria scripture lint` reports every line that breaks the grammar or the rules of lesson-sharing T4; the parser is tolerant.
$comment: Generated by `pnpm schemas` from the zod source in packages/domain/src/schema (ADR 0003): change the zod source, never this file. created_at is the date encoded in the id; last_hit_at and retired_at come from the ledger beside the scripture, so all three are dates, not date-times. A session loads at most 40 lines after scope filtering, the character's scripture first, then the temple's (SCRIPTURE_LINES_MAX); a file has no cap. helped and missed are computed from load traces, never stored. Not expressible here: created_at equals the date in the id; text holds no line break.

version.description: Set by the parser; the Markdown line itself carries no version.

owner.description: A character slug, or `temple` for the shared scripture.

source_verdict.description: Verdict the lesson comes from; required when source = monk.

scope.description: Where a lesson loads (PS-12): every key present must match the session, values of one key are alternatives. Absent, the lesson loads in every session. The CLI version is no filter but where the lesson was measured (cli_version, lesson-sharing S5).

role.description: The role of the session: assignee, verifier.

class.description: The character's class, a registry id.

tribe.description: The character's tribe, an id of kingdom.tribes[].

os.description: The OS the Steward runs on.

territory.description: The quest's territory: a scope that never leaves the kingdom (lesson-sharing S2, P3).

tag.description: At least one of these tags on the quest.

fail_kind.description: The kind of failure the lesson cures (lesson-sharing S3): what helped and missed count against.

cli_version.description: The CLI version the lesson was measured on (lesson-sharing S5, T7): a record, never a filter.

origin.description: Where a lesson from outside the kingdom came from (lesson-sharing S4, T9).

from.description: The release or the pack the lesson came with.

lesson.description: Its id, or the ref of its sentence, where it came from.

received_at.description: The day the owner took it in.

examples.text: Run `pnpm i18n:check` before submitting any locale change.
Never read .env or infra/secrets; ask for the secret by name.
Compare commits with `git diff <base>...HEAD` and read files with `git show HEAD:<path>`.
